_note: Lane book recipe (tv_scan_cli.py lane-book; generic_utils/lane_book.py). A lane is one SQL condition on the panel store's features (plus ai, the cluster flag, and <field>_pr, the day's percent rank of each pct_fields entry); the same condition gives the lane's record on every past store day and its names today. defs are macros ({name}) for lane conditions. Lanes were written from earlier findings on the same store (signal lab print cells, the 11 Nov mover study, the deterioration playbook, anatomy tests): their record is in-sample, mostly one regime. side long / avoid / base only groups the page; nothing is ranked across lanes. Knobs here, judgment on the page.

lanes.label: Every name on the floor (the base rate)
lanes.why: What the average US $2B+ name did: every lane is read against this row.

lanes.label: Quality repairing from depth
lanes.why: FCF margin 10%+, estimates not cut, net debt under 2x EBITDA, and under the 200-day or 30%+ under the high: the 11 Nov mover study's edge, without a move trigger.

lanes.label: Quality from depth, turning (week +5%)
lanes.why: The same quality-from-depth names once the week turns up 5%+: the repair with price confirmation.

lanes.label: Quality from depth after a +7% day
lanes.why: The mover-study cell (a big up day on a strong, deep name); thin, read its n.

lanes.label: Quality uptrend back at the 50-day
lanes.where: {strong} AND vs200 > 0 AND vs50 BETWEEN -6 AND 1 AND r_3m > 0
lanes.why: Strong names in an uptrend that pulled back to their 50-day: buy-the-dip inside a trend.

lanes.label: Cheaper than peers, estimates up, turning up
lanes.where: ey_fwd_ri >= 2 AND eps_rev_3m > 0 AND r_1w > 0 AND vs50 < 0
lanes.why: Forward earnings yield 2+ points over the industry median, estimates rising, still under the 50-day but up on the week.

lanes.label: Estimates up 5%+, price down on the month
lanes.why: The street raised next-year EPS 5%+ over 3 months while the price fell: revisions the tape has not paid.

lanes.label: Street 30%+ over, estimates not cut, cash positive, 25%+ under the high
lanes.where: pt_up >= 30 AND eps_rev_3m >= 0 AND fcf_margin > 0 AND hi_prox <= -25
lanes.why: A deep drawdown the street still prices 30%+ higher, with estimates intact and cash coming in.

lanes.label: Quality washed out (RSI 35 or under)
lanes.why: Strong businesses at an oversold RSI: the washed-out entry.

lanes.label: Low bar into the print (sold into it, last print sold, revisions not crowded)
lanes.where: dte BETWEEN 1 AND 14 AND r_1m < 0 AND react_last < 0 AND coalesce(eps_rev_3m, 0) < 6.6
lanes.why: The signal lab's best pre-print cell on the store: price down into the print, the last print sold off, revisions under the crowded top quintile.

lanes.label: Build-up: strong and cheaper than peers, print in 8-28 days
lanes.why: Quality cheaper than its industry with a print three to four weeks out: bought before the event, not chased after it.

lanes.label: Beat both and gapped up 3%+ (post-print drift)
lanes.why: Printed in the last 3 days, beat EPS and revenue, the reaction day closed up 3%+.

lanes.label: Beat both, sold 3%+ on the print
lanes.where: dsp BETWEEN 0 AND 5 AND {beat_both} AND react_last <= -3
lanes.why: A beat on both lines that the market sold: the dip after a good print.

lanes.label: Moving without a print (week +4%, volume up, cheaper than peers)
lanes.why: Up 4%+ on the week on above-average volume with no print in 10 days or the next 5, cheaper than peers: buying without a catalyst.

lanes.label: AI cluster quality 20%+ under the high
lanes.why: The AI / data-center cluster's strong names after the drawdown: the contagion lane, read with the cluster triggers.

lanes.label: Any +7% day (chasing the move)
lanes.why: The base for chasing: what a +7% day did next, any name.

lanes.label: Momentum at the high (within 5%, estimates +10%, 3 months +30%)
lanes.why: The crowded winner: near the high with estimates and price both already up a lot.

lanes.label: Big mover the continuation score likes (top fifth)
lanes.why: A big move the move-prediction continuation score ranks in its top fifth.

lanes.label: Cash burner after a big move
lanes.why: A +7% day or +15% week on a business with negative free cash flow.

lanes.label: Rich to peers, up 10%+ on the month into a print within 10 days
lanes.where: ey_fwd_ri <= -2 AND dte BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND r_1m >= 10
lanes.why: Priced over its industry and run up into the print: the sell-the-news set-up.

lanes.label: Estimates cut 5%+, under the 200-day, month down
lanes.why: The falling knife: the business and the price going down together (short-side reading).

value_labels.ey_fwd_ri: forward earnings yield vs the industry median (Q5 = cheapest)
value_labels.sales_yield_ri: sales yield vs the industry median (Q5 = cheapest)
